parsed.title: Discussion about living and working abroad in Slovakia and Austria

topics.title: People living in Slovakia or abroad

claims.text: There are members who live in Bratislava or elsewhere in Slovakia.
Some participants have friends or acquaintances in Austria and Poland.
One user has been living in Slovakia for almost a year without speaking the local language.
LinkedIn is recommended as the main tool for job searching.
The user applied to about 100 vacancies and got only 3 interviews.

topics.title: Language expectations in the job market

claims.text: German is commonly used, but many communications happen in English.
95% of vacancies state that a local language is required.
Some companies accept candidates with limited language skills if other criteria are met.
Applicants with 2‑3 years of experience receive higher offers than those with less experience.
Even with minimal experience, a candidate was invited to a mid‑level interview.
The speaker accepted the minimum salary to get a job quickly.

topics.title: Considerations for moving to another country

claims.text: Language barrier in everyday life is a concern for newcomers.
Attending international tech events and Discord channels is suggested to improve English conversation skills.
